comment: sptd mode only. python-hello-user runs as a measured CPython script target (python-script-stdlib.json: the real interpreter /usr/local/bin/python3.11 with -I -B -S, python and python3 as aliases). The command is the absolute script /app/print_env.py; the image's own command is not one of the two forms a script contract accepts. print_env.py uses only the standard library, so -S (no site-packages) is set; v1 and v2 share this override. The demo's manifests and the sgx/cvm modes are unchanged. API_PASSWORD (from the api-credentials SconeSecret) is removed in sptd mode: offline onboarding has no CAS to generate it, and the sptd scone variants leave the SconeSecret out.
